topics.topic: Tall and Short, Long and Short

easy.question: Which is TALLER: a coconut tree or a puppy?
easy.explanation: A coconut tree is much taller than a puppy.

easy.question: Which is SHORTER: an elephant or a hen?
easy.explanation: A hen is shorter than an elephant.

easy.question: A python is ______ than a garden lizard. (longer / shorter)
easy.explanation: A python is much longer than a small garden lizard.

easy.question: Which is LONGER: a train or a bike?
easy.explanation: A train is much longer than a bike.

medium.question: Look at a matchstick and a broomstick. Which is longer? Which is shorter?
medium.answer: The broomstick is longer. The matchstick is shorter.
medium.explanation: We compare the length of objects to say which is longer or shorter.

medium.question: Lina's Baba is the tallest and Rit is the shortest. Who is taller: Baba or Rit?
medium.explanation: The tallest person is always taller than the shortest person.

hard.question: Put in order from shortest to tallest: a mushroom, a child, a banyan tree, a beetle.
hard.answer: Beetle, Mushroom, Child, Banyan tree (from shortest to tallest).
hard.explanation: A beetle is the smallest, then a mushroom, then a child, and a banyan tree is the tallest.

topics.name: Meet Lina's Family

topics.topic: Thick and Thin, Heavy and Light

easy.question: Which is THICK: a banyan tree trunk or a kite string?
easy.explanation: A banyan tree trunk is thick. A kite string is thin.

easy.question: A cotton ball is ______ and a sack of wheat is heavy.
easy.explanation: A cotton ball weighs very little, so it is light.

easy.question: Which is HEAVIER: a pumpkin or a tomato?
easy.explanation: A pumpkin is much heavier than a small tomato.

easy.question: Which is THIN?
easy.explanation: A kite string is very thin compared to the other objects.

medium.question: Name one heavy thing and one light thing from your kitchen.
medium.answer: Heavy: iron kadhai or bag of potatoes. Light: a spoon or a plastic plate.
medium.explanation: Heavy things weigh more and light things weigh less.

medium.question: Which is heavier: an empty jhola (cloth bag) or a schoolbag full of books?
medium.answer: A schoolbag full of books is heavier.
medium.explanation: A bag full of books is much heavier than an empty cloth bag.

hard.question: Put these in order from lightest to heaviest: a cotton ball, a wooden chair, a rubber ball, a sack of wheat.
hard.answer: Cotton ball, Rubber ball, Wooden chair, Sack of wheat (from lightest to heaviest).
hard.explanation: A cotton ball is the lightest and a sack of wheat is the heaviest.

topics.name: Tall and Short

easy.question: A handspan is the distance from your ______ to your little finger when your hand is spread open.
easy.explanation: A handspan goes from the tip of the thumb to the tip of the little finger.

easy.question: For measuring big distances like a room, we can use our ______.
easy.explanation: A footspan (the length of your foot) is used for bigger distances.

easy.question: Which would you use to measure a small key: handspan or footspan?
easy.explanation: For small objects, a handspan (or even finger widths) works better.

medium.question: Why might you and your Dadi get different answers when measuring the same shawl with handspans?
medium.answer: Because your hands are different sizes. Dadi's hand may be bigger than yours.
medium.explanation: Handspans differ from person to person based on hand size.

medium.question: Would you use a handspan or a footspan to measure the length of the verandah?
medium.answer: A footspan, because the verandah is very long.
medium.explanation: Footspans are better for large distances. Handspans are better for small objects.

hard.question: Lina measured her pillow with her handspan and got 5 handspans. Her brother Rit measured the same pillow and got 7 handspans. Why did they get different answers?
hard.answer: Lina has bigger hands than Rit, so her handspan is larger. She needs fewer handspans to cover the same distance. Rit has smaller hands, so he needs more handspans.
hard.explanation: A bigger handspan covers more distance with each measure, so fewer handspans are needed.

easy.question: Which holds MORE water: a balti (bucket) or a glass?
easy.explanation: A balti is much bigger and holds more water than a glass.

easy.question: A lota holds ______ water than a balti. (more / less)
easy.explanation: A lota is smaller than a balti, so it holds less water.

easy.question: Which holds the LEAST water?
easy.explanation: A spoon is the smallest and holds the least water.

medium.question: Put in order from holds least to holds most: balti, glass, spoon, lota.
medium.explanation: Spoon holds the least, then glass, then lota, and balti holds the most.

hard.question: Why should we not waste water? Give two ways to save water.
hard.answer: Water is precious and we need it to live. Two ways: use a balti for bathing instead of a shower, and close the tap tightly after washing hands.
hard.explanation: Saving water helps the environment and makes sure there is enough for everyone.
